comment: Hand-transcribed expected ubus file.exec decisions for luci-mod-network-config ifup/ifdown/wifi from pinned rpcd-mod-file C, network JS callers, and ACL JSON. Not generated from the Python evaluator.
notes: uh_ubus_allowed requires session.access scope=ubus object=file function=exec (uhttpd omits scope). rpcd-mod-file then checks file.exec of the canonicalized executable first, then the cmdline.
Bounded to fs.exec callers at luci b2e0be4b: interfaces.js /sbin/ifup and /sbin/ifdown, wireless.js /sbin/wifi up.
Inventoried luci-ssl ACLs grant the bare executables. Extra tokens therefore match at the executable stage as intended_access for the write fixture, not authorization_violation and not a PoC.
Missing SID is JSON-RPC ERROR_PARSE, not the all-zero sentinel.
Unauthenticated is ERROR_ACCESS at uh_ubus_allowed. A ubus file.exec grant without the matching file ACL is UBUS_STATUS_PERMISSION_DENIED.
The luci-mod-network-config read fixture has ubus file.exec but not write file.exec of ifup/ifdown/wifi.
Root list read/write '*' is stock rpcd.config, not a violation (expectation_id root-administration).
Do not emit dispatcher, authorization_violation, path_found, luci object grants, or execv.
shellquote and basename are not sanitizers. rpc_canonicalize_path is not a taint sanitizer.
luci-mod-status iptables -Z / routes ip stay on policy:ubus-file-exec-v1.
luci-mod-network diagnostics ping and luci-mod-status-processes /bin/kill are not this slice.

rule_refs: luci@b2e0be4b luci-base.json unauthenticated grants only luci.getFeatures
rpcd@d99f703 unauthenticated.json has no ubus file.exec
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c uh_ubus_allowed: session.access file/exec false -> ERROR_ACCESS
do not invent an unauthenticated ifup grant
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c parse_call_params: missing SID with no_ubusauth=0 is ERROR_PARSE
missing SID is not rewritten to 0000... in luci-ssl-25.12

luci@b2e0be4b luci-mod-network.json luci-mod-network-config.write.file./sbin/ifup=[exec]
luci@b2e0be4b interfaces.js fs.exec('/sbin/ifup', [sid])
rpcd@d99f703 file.c rpc_file_exec_run executable ACL first
